name: Last.fm
author: Vibo
description: Scrobbling, now playing, history import, and metadata from Last.fm

permissionReasons.network:ws.audioscrobbler.com: Talk to Last.fm: scrobbles, bios, similar artists and tracks, tags
permissionReasons.system:open: Open the Last.fm sign-in page and your Last.fm profile in your browser
permissionReasons.playback:read: See what's playing, to scrobble it and update Now Playing on Last.fm
permissionReasons.playback:control: Play an album's full tracklist, or a radio of similar songs, when you ask it to
permissionReasons.library:read: Love or unlove a track on Last.fm when you like it, and base mixes on what you've played
permissionReasons.library:write: Import your Last.fm scrobbles into History and your loved tracks as likes
permissionReasons.env:LASTFM_API_SECRET: Sign requests to Last.fm with Vibo's API secret
permissionReasons.plugins:call: Check that a source such as yt-dlp is installed before offering radio and mixes of songs you don't own

assistant.instructions: Last.fm scrobbling + account data. Public data (artist bios, similar artists/tracks, top tracks, tags) is served through the info types — use POST /v1/info/fetch (or the get_entity_info tool), optionally with pluginId=lastfm. These tools cover the ACCOUNT half the local library can't know: cross-device listening from the user's Last.fm profile. All of them need the user to be connected (check account_status first).

tools.name: account_status
tools.description: Whether Last.fm is connected, and as which username

tools.name: recent_scrobbles
tools.description: The user's latest scrobbles from their Last.fm account — includes plays from OTHER devices/apps, unlike the local history

tools.name: top_charts
tools.description: The user's personal Last.fm charts (account-wide, cross-device)

informationTypes.name: Top Songs
informationTypes.description: Most popular songs by play count

informationTypes.name: Similar Artists
informationTypes.description: Artists with a similar sound or style
